description.blurb: Geirrod (formerly S/2004 S38 and Saturn LXVI) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Geirrod was a Norse giant killed by Thor. Geirrod is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1211.02 days, at an inclination of 154° to the ecliptic.
